attributes.has_name: Case A — Tiger not detected (unusual animal pose)
attributes.malfunction_description: Analysis case A. Functional insufficiency: classifier generalization limitation. Triggering condition: unusual animal pose. Outcome: Tiger not detected. The classifier and sensing chain operate without a fault, but the learned representation does not adequately cover the pose.

attributes.has_name: Case C2 — Tiger not detected (low thermal contrast)
attributes.malfunction_description: Follow-up assessment of runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001, which introduced thermal sensing and evaluation to address Case C1. Functional insufficiency: limited contrast discrimination. Triggering condition: low target–background thermal contrast. Outcome: Tiger not detected. The infrared channel operates without a fault, but the intended function cannot reliably discriminate the target from its thermal background. This limits the thermal measure's effectiveness, including when camouflage and partial concealment coincide with low thermal contrast.

attributes.has_name: Sensor set insufficient for operating condition
attributes.malfunction_description: Without a sensor fault, the specified fusion policy credits modalities that provide insufficient information for the current environment, for example visible imagery in darkness. The intended sensor allocation cannot meet the detection target. Fault-induced channel loss remains outside this concern.

attributes.has_name: Case C1 — Tiger not detected (camouflage and partial concealment)
attributes.malfunction_description: The original sensor configuration used RGB and lidar. A tiger remaining still against a similar-looking background and using partial vegetation cover may present too few discriminating features for timely recognition, even when both sensors function correctly. Functional insufficiency: insufficient sensing diversity for visually concealed targets. Triggering condition: camouflage and partial concealment. Outcome: Tiger not detected. Runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001 adds thermal sensing and evaluation to address this concern in the current baseline.

attributes.has_name: Case B — Tiger not detected (small apparent target size)
attributes.malfunction_description: Analysis case B. Functional insufficiency: limited spatial resolution. Triggering condition: small apparent target size. Outcome: Tiger not detected. The correctly operating sensor resolves too few target features for reliable recognition.

attributes.has_name: Case A-SW — Tiger classification false negative (unusual animal pose)
attributes.malfunction_description: Software contribution to system Case A. With qualified fused inputs and an object hypothesis for a tiger, TigerDetectionApp produces tigerDetected=false at detectionOut throughout the required detection window for an unusual pose. The classifier executes correctly but its learned representation does not generalize sufficiently. This output insufficiency can contribute to the system missed detection unless another mechanism compensates; it is not an independent hazardous scenario or an implementation fault.

Without an implementation or hardware fault, the operating-condition estimator has insufficient sensitivity to heavy rain, glare, or aperture obstruction. Detection performance falls outside its validated conditions without a timely operator warning.
